assignments.mission: Using only the provided facts, choose A, B, or C and justify with the single most important reason; present the strongest counterargument; name the pivotal assumption that would flip the choice; and outline a three-year plan to reduce irreversibility (architecture, packaging/pricing, contracts, partner tactics, decision checkpoints) within the constraint of one primary direction.

reason: The decision, counterargument, key assumption, and risk-mitigation plan are core business-strategy tasks based solely on given inputs; no external research or brand work is required. One strategist can deliver a high-quality answer with minimal collaboration.
